Type: glazed ceramic table lamp
Use: accent and bedside light; bedroom, living room, home office; on a nightstand, side table or shelf
Style: contemporary, coastal, bohemian
Materials: glossy crackle-glazed ceramic base with relief pattern, linen-look fabric shade, nickel neck
Colors: dark teal blue, white
Shape: small bottle-shaped base with a flared neck and raised geometric triangle pattern, tall cylindrical drum shade, compact
Feel: crafted, cozy, rich
Goes with: white walls, natural wood, navy or rattan accents; coastal or eclectic rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Ceramic Table Lamp, 18"H, Crackle Dark Blue
product.description: The intricate ceramic pattern with a tone-on-tone blue-crackle glaze finish gives this lamp a true artisanal flair that blends with a variety of styles and decor. 8.5"W x 8.5"D x 17.5"H Dark-blue glossed crackle glazed ceramic base; brushed-nickel accents; off-white linen drum shade This bold ceramic lamp is paired with an off-white linen drum shade to cast perfect ambient light. Includes 1 60-watt equivalent LED bulb included
